confirmed_findings.title: stale host snapshot resurrects spent native value
confirmed_findings.witness: CREATE_POOL debits 1000 native from 10000 and returns patch 9000; a second app call with the unchanged 10000 host snapshot restores the account to 10000.
confirmed_findings.required_disposition: Bind one authenticated current native-custody snapshot to the head and atomically consume the returned patch, or include native custody directly in the authoritative ZenoLedger state transition.

confirmed_findings.title: caller-constructible native snapshot acts as a direct writer
confirmed_findings.witness: apply_app_tx on empty state with chain_balances={attacker:1000000000} and no operations accepts a state containing that native balance.
confirmed_findings.required_disposition: Replace the mapping authority with an opaque host-authenticated snapshot or current-head custody witness and kill stale, altered, foreign-deployment, and noncanonical-account mutations.

confirmed_findings.title: unknown operation stream is accepted as a successful no-op
confirmed_findings.witness: operations stream 99 containing a mint-shaped payload returns ok=true, a nonempty state, and a nonempty state hash.
confirmed_findings.required_disposition: Admit a closed top-level operation language and reject unknown, duplicate, or conflicting current and legacy streams before evaluation.

confirmed_findings.title: cardinality-only outbox model admitted a phantom deliverable effect
confirmed_findings.witness: initial -> advance_head_with_independent_safe_commit -> deliver_next_effect delivered one effect although no candidate or effect record existed.
confirmed_findings.required_disposition: The current model no longer creates outbox capacity on an unrelated head advance; full EffectId, payload, destination, acknowledgment, and destination-idempotency refinement remain open.

confirmed_findings.title: stale-candidate rejection mutated the complete modeled state
confirmed_findings.witness: stage mint -> independent head advance -> reject_stale_candidate cleared candidate fields while reporting rejection no-op.
confirmed_findings.required_disposition: The current stale rejection performs no update. Transient candidate cleanup and durable rejection remain separate lifecycle relations.

confirmed_findings.title: fee-staking apportionment lacks a productive dust policy
confirmed_findings.witness: one whole-zUSD fee over three equal fee shares produces 99999999 E8 claimable units and one E8 residue; the current bridge fails closed because pool and claimants are unequal.
evidence: local arithmetic reproduction: fee_e8=100000000, claimable_e8=99999999, unassigned_dust_e8=1
confirmed_findings.required_disposition: Choose a deterministic residue owner or residual allocator and prove exact claimability and terminal drain, or explicitly restrict accepted stake configurations and document the availability boundary.

confirmed_findings.title: desired multi-vault redemption scenario exceeds mounted implementation
confirmed_findings.witness: BDD-028 promises a committing redemption across multiple vaults while the baseline core rejects unimplemented prefix traversal and full-close surplus routing.
confirmed_findings.required_disposition: Mount and prove prefix traversal and surplus routing, or mark the scenario unsupported and require deterministic rejection.

confirmed_findings.title: desired exact debt close lacks a mounted command path
confirmed_findings.witness: BDD-025 promises exact close while baseline repayment rejects exact repayment and the main command union has no owner-close tag.
confirmed_findings.required_disposition: Mount the separate owner-close transition through the same authority and publication path, or declare exact close unsupported.

required_spec_expansions.title: native custody snapshot and patch mediation
minimum_acceptance: A native custody snapshot binds chain, deployment, head, height, canonical accounts, and source receipt.
Sequential transitions consume the committed post-snapshot rather than reusing the block pre-snapshot.
The native patch and internal native delta publish at one linearization point.
Altered, stale, foreign, duplicate-account, and noncanonical snapshots reject without mutation.

required_spec_expansions.title: closed operation language and profile isolation
minimum_acceptance: Unknown streams and duplicate semantic variants reject.
Current and legacy aliases cannot coexist unless exact equivalence is proved.
Faucet, unsigned-intent, permissive-settlement, and isolated-perps flags belong to a root-bound test-only profile that production rejects.

required_spec_expansions.title: complete economic state and delta certificate
minimum_acceptance: Every asset source, sink, custody bucket, claim, reserve, reward, fee, margin, PnL, and residue appears in one typed delta certificate.
Native collateral, Stability Pool collateral, protocol collateral, reward custody, DEX pools, LP supply, and perps liabilities are reconciled alongside zUSD.
Zero, one, max-minus-one, max, overflow, rounding, and dust boundaries are executable.

required_spec_expansions.title: fee staking and fee-owner lifecycle
minimum_acceptance: stake_fee_shares, activate_fee_stake, unstake_fee_shares, claim_protocol_fees, claim_host_fees, claim_staking_fees, and claim_fee_rewards are explicit workflows.
Every current fee owner, reserve, reward debt, residue, and terminal drain reconciles exactly.

required_spec_expansions.title: zUSD exact close and multi-vault redemption
minimum_acceptance: The mounted command language explicitly supports or excludes owner close and multi-vault redemption.
Full-close surplus, ordering, fees, collateral, debt, and terminal state are atomically bound.

required_spec_expansions.title: perps operator and funding-closeout recovery
minimum_acceptance: Market parameter changes, partial liquidation, insurance deposits, funding application, carried liabilities, and recovery settlements have explicit value and authority contracts.
zUSD and perps share one authenticated world-price context or reject divergence.

required_spec_expansions.title: pool creation and generic non-managed token lifecycle
minimum_acceptance: CREATE_POOL binds both debits, reserves, locked LP shares, creator shares, fee profile, curve, nonce, and duplicate-pool rejection.
Generic mint and burn apply only to an explicitly allowed non-managed asset profile with exact supply conservation.

required_spec_expansions.title: cancellation expiry and abandonment
minimum_acceptance: Every pending asset-bearing intent, perps request, and sealed-bid bond has an explicit cancellation, expiry, abandonment, refund, slash, or permanent-rejection owner.
Expiry cannot strand custody or recreate value on retry.

required_spec_expansions.title: effect identity delivery and acknowledgment
minimum_acceptance: Each external effect binds commit, ordinal, destination, payload, adapter profile, and writer epoch.
Delivery requires committed membership and destination idempotency; acknowledgment retains the same lineage.
Internal ZenoLedger balance changes never create outbox work.

required_spec_expansions.title: competing publication and reopen authority
minimum_acceptance: At least two immutable candidates can race on one head and exactly one can commit.
Canonical reopen accepts exact PRE or POST or rejects and never restores writer authority without a fresh head-bound latch.

required_spec_expansions.title: workflow to model and evidence coverage registry
minimum_acceptance: Every workflow and invariant maps to exact model actions, implementation entrypoints, publication paths, and executable evidence, or carries an explicit GAP or EXCLUDED status.
No prose-only workflow contributes to completeness or promotion.

scope_decisions.rule: The production command registry, UI submit paths, recovery paths, and publisher must make shutdown activation unreachable; the research extension carries no authority.

Commitment, bond custody, reveal, deterministic clearing, asset settlement, refund, slash, cancellation, expiry, replay, crash recovery, and no-bypass must join the same M6 subject before the UI can move value.
A root-bound test deployment profile may enable them; every production or unknown profile rejects.

scope_decisions.feature: generic non-zUSD token mint and burn
scope_decisions.rule: Production ordinary assets default to transfer-only; each allowed issue or burn path requires a named versioned asset profile, while zUSD, LP shares, native coin, and ZDEX use their protocol-specific authorities.
They may propose commands and must pass the same authentication, core, publication, and no-bypass path.

Native balances and all same-ledger custody changes publish atomically in ZenoLedger; only genuinely external destinations use committed effect identity, retry-safe delivery, and acknowledgment lineage.
